name: processor-board
title: The processor board
subtitle: Seafood Processing for Claude Code: what needs a decision, fish on the floor, open orders and the cold store. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Food safety and legal holds first: held landings, histamine, shellfish without clearance. Then what blocks a dispatch, then condition and money.
sections.sql: select case reason when 'landing_held' then 'HELD at the door' when 'histamine_over' then 'HISTAMINE over the limit' when 'shellfish_no_clearance' then 'Shellfish with no area clearance' when 'histamine_missing' then 'No histamine result: cannot dispatch' when 'ecert_missing' then 'Export with no E-cert: cannot leave' when 'coolstore_out_of_range' then 'Cold store OUT OF RANGE' when 'use_by_passed' then 'Past use-by in store' when 'permit_expired' then 'Fisher permit EXPIRED' when 'order_late' then 'Order past its required date' when 'landing_unprocessed' then 'Fish waiting for the line' when 'yield_low' then 'Yield under standard' when 'use_by_close' then 'Use-by inside two days' when 'landing_unpriced' then 'No price: cannot settle' when 'coolstore_quiet' then 'Cold store check overdue' when 'permit_expiring' then 'Fisher permit expiring' else reason end as what, label as record, who, detail from v_attention order by array_position(array['landing_held','histamine_over','shellfish_no_clearance','histamine_missing','ecert_missing','coolstore_out_of_range','use_by_passed','permit_expired','order_late','landing_unprocessed','yield_low','use_by_close','landing_unpriced','coolstore_quiet','permit_expiring'], reason), days desc nulls last

sections.title: Fish on the floor
sections.note: Received or held, not yet through the line. Fish is condition and condition is money.
sections.sql: select ref as lot, to_char(landed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as landed, vessel, fisher, species, kg, coalesce(receive_temp_c || ' C', '') as received_at, case when temp_breach then 'OVER LIMIT' else '' end as temp, case when bivalve then coalesce(shellfish_clearance_ref, 'NO CLEARANCE') else '' end as area_clearance, upper(status) as status, coalesce(hold_reason, '') as hold_reason from v_landings where status in ('received', 'held') order by status desc, landed_on

sections.title: Open orders
sections.note: An export order does not dispatch without its E-cert reference, and no scombroid case leaves without a histamine result. There is no force flag.
sections.sql: select ref as order, customer, case when export then 'EXPORT ' || coalesce(destination, '') else 'domestic' end as type, to_char(required_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as required, kg_ordered as ordered_kg, kg_allocated as allocated_kg, case when export then coalesce(ecert_ref, 'MISSING') else '' end as e_cert, case when cases_untested > 0 then cases_untested || ' untested' else '' end as histamine, round(invoice_value, 2) as value_at_catch_weight from v_orders where status = 'open' order by required_on

sections.title: The cold store
sections.note: The temperature record is what the RMP verifier reads. A quiet room is a gap in it.
sections.sql: select room, kind, target_min_c || ' to ' || target_max_c || ' C' as band, coalesce(last_temp_c || ' C', '') as last_reading, coalesce(round(hours_since) || 'h ago', 'NEVER') as checked, coalesce(checked_by, '') as by, cases_in_room as cases, state from v_coolstore order by case state when 'OUT OF RANGE' then 1 when 'NEVER CHECKED' then 2 when 'QUIET' then 3 else 4 end, room

name: registers
title: The registers
subtitle: Seafood Processing for Claude Code: yields, stock on hand, fisher permits and what is owed. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Yields, last 30 days
sections.note: Against your own standard per species. A run five points under is flagged on the attention list.
sections.sql: select ref as run, to_char(run_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as run_on, landing_ref as lot, species, vessel, input_kg as in_kg, output_kg as out_kg, yield_pct || '%' as yield, coalesce(standard_yield_pct || '%', '') as standard, yield_gap as gap from v_runs where run_on > current_date - 30 order by run_on desc

sections.title: Stock on hand
sections.sql: select product_code as product, product as description, storage, count(*) as cases, sum(net_kg) as kg, count(*) filter (where order_id is null) as unallocated, to_char(min(use_by), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as first_use_by, string_agg(distinct coalesce(room, ''), ', ') as rooms from v_cases where status = 'in_store' group by product_code, product, storage order by storage, product_code

sections.title: Fisher permits and money owed
sections.note: A licensed fish receiver buys only from a current permit holder.
sections.sql: select code, name as fisher, coalesce(permit_no, 'NONE') as permit, coalesce(to_char(permit_expires_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') as expires, permit as state, kg_30d as kg_last_30_days, round(owed_unsettled, 2) as owed_not_settled from v_fishers where status = 'active' order by case permit when 'EXPIRED' then 1 when 'NONE' then 2 when 'expiring' then 3 else 4 end, name

sections.title: Settlements
sections.sql: select ref, fisher, to_char(period_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as period_to, landings as lots, kg, round(gross, 2) as gross, round(deductions, 2) as deductions, round(net, 2) as net, status from v_settlements order by period_to desc
